outline: This goal of this course is to provide fundamental concepts and advanced applications of fuzzy sets and algebraic operations, fuzzy reasoning, fuzzy logic controls and fuzzy system design so that students can apply them to their research in the competitive world.
schedule:
week 1~2: Introduction
week 3~4: Fuzzy sets
week 5~6: Fuzzy relations
week 7~8: Membership functions, fuzzification and defuzzification
week 9: Mid-term exam.
week 10~12: Logic and fuzzy systems
week 13~14: Automated methods for fuzzy systems
week 15~16: Fuzzy classification
week 17: Fuzzy control systems
week 18: Final exam
